image.pixel_coordinate_convention: continuous coordinates, origin = top-left corner of the top-left pixel, x right, y down; pixel (i,j) covers [i,i+1)x[j,j+1); bbox_px = [x0,y0,x1,y1) with x1,y1 exclusive; center_px = bbox centre

grid.slot_order: reading order (row-major), the four corner slots are markers

colorimetry.lab: CIE 1976 L*a*b* relative to the D65 white above
colorimetry.design_hue_angle: h_ab = atan2(b*, a*) in degrees, 0 = +a*, counter-clockwise
colorimetry.hsv_hue: colorsys.rgb_to_hsv of the 8-bit sRGB values, degrees

neutral.note: sRGB 230 is L*=91.29, slightly brighter than the L*90 grey (sRGB 226); the L*10 grey (sRGB 27) quantises to L*9.77

meta.markers_note: checkerboard markers in the four corner slots; cell counts TL=3, TR=4, BR=6, BL=8; black 0 / white 255; each has an 18 px white border; top-left cell is black; inner_corners_px are the interior grid-line crossings in pixel coordinates
